ESMA MiCA Article 3: EMT must reference one official currency and an issuer
Avant: savUSD is a yield-bearing senior-tranche token received by staking avUSD

applicabilityBasis.summary: savUSD is a yield-bearing senior-tranche wrapper received by staking avUSD; its exchange rate accrues value and its exit is a conversion back to avUSD, not fixed-value payment redemption.

references.label: GENIUS Act text: payment stablecoin definition and yield restriction
Avant: savUSD senior tranche and accruing exchange rate

genius.notes: savUSD is the yield-bearing senior tranche of Avant's avUSD system, not the base dollar token: Avant says staking avUSD produces savUSD and that its exchange rate continuously increases as strategy yield accrues. It is therefore treated as a non-payment-token for GENIUS and no payment-stablecoin authorization status is asserted.
